same_thing.v1/same_thing.instructions: Are the two categories in the state the same thing, named two ways?

criteria.true: Both categories hold sessions about one subject: either one's description and session titles would fit the other, and the names differ in wording only.
criteria.false: The categories cover two subjects, or one covers part of what the other does, even when their names share a word.
